display_name: The Fourteen Thousand Infants of Bethlehem

names.form: Cei 14.000 de prunci uciși din porunca lui Irod
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 decembrie, «Sfinții 14.000 de prunci uciși din porunca lui Irod».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγια Νήπια (περίπου 14.000) που εσφάγισαν με διαταγή του Ηρώδη». The page's name for the company is the one word Νήπια, the Infants, and the rest of its line is the number and the manner of their death; the rank word Άγια is left off.

names.form: Мученики 14000 младенцев, от Ирода в Вифлееме избиенные
names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Мученики 14000 младенцев, от Ирода в Вифлееме избиенные» and carries no rank word to strip beyond «Мученики», which is part of the company’s own designation and is kept. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the folder had no Cyrillic form.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru in the day line this folder already cites: «(I)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Мучеников 14000 младенцев , от Ирода в Вифлееме избиенных (I).»

attestations.note: The day’s first entry after the afterfeast, and the same menologion day, 29 December, as the folder’s Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows. The line’s «Мучеников» is the `martyr` the folder’s `types` already carry. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the line’s «(I)» is a bare Roman numeral and this wave has declined to write a date off one. The reading life3193 was NOT OPENED, the folder’s life being already written. THREE HYMNS TAKEN, the day’s whole set for them, where the folder had none of this calendar’s; its two existing hymns were not touched. The third, printed as «Кондак младенцев» without the number, is a second kontakion of the same memory and is stored as one.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 decembrie — «Sfinții 14.000 de prunci uciși din porunca lui Irod»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγια Νήπια (περίπου 14.000) που εσφάγισαν με διαταγή του Ηρώδη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps on the Romanian calendar, and the entry is the same company, named the same way: a number and no members. saint.gr hedges the number where doxologia.ro does not, «περίπου 14.000», about fourteen thousand. It gives no year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. It names three places of relics — the greater part at the Patriarchate of Jerusalem, portions at the monastery of Pantokrator on the Holy Mountain, and «ίσως μερικά», perhaps some, at Constantinople in the church of Saint James the Brother of God which Justin raised — and none of these is drafted as a location, nor is the church a relation. It prints an apolytikion and a kontakion, both of which name the Infants, and both are taken. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.01.2026 (29. децембар ст. ст.) — „Светих четрнаест хиљада младенаца витлејемских.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and it is ONE FOLDER AND NOT FOURTEEN THOUSAND: the heading gives the company a count and a town and enumerates nobody, and the body names no child at all, which is BRIEF.md §4’s ruling and is how the 12-21 and 12-28 readers handled the three Nicomedian companies. Identified on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep the company, and on Herod’s order itself. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND NONE WRITTEN: the folder has none, and what this entry gives is not a year but a distance — «изврши се годину дана по рођењу Христовом 29. децембра», done a year after the birth of Christ, on 29 December — which is a span from an undated event and the day the folder already keeps, so it goes in no field. `types` untouched: «мученаца» is the `martyr` the folder carries. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS, and goes into the life: that the order was carried out «дословце», to the letter, and HOW — some cut down with the sword, some broken against a stone, some crushed underfoot, some strangled with the hands; the mothers’ weeping rising to heaven, with Jeremiah 31:15 and Matthew 2:18 cited; and then the whole of what became of Herod, which is the entry’s second half and is not about the children at all. FIVE PERSONS ARE NAMED IN THAT SECOND HALF AND NOT ONE TAKES A ROW OR A LINK. Захарија, killed in the temple at Herod’s order for not giving up his son; Јован, the son Herod sought, thinking him the new King; свети Симеон Богопримац, who would have been killed too had he not been taken to God soon after the Meeting; Иркан the high priest and the seventy elders of the Sanhedrin, killed for having told Herod where the Messiah was to be born. The heading names the children alone and carries NO company clause, so the 12-19 reader’s `aglaia-of-rome` ruling decides it — a name inside a body is not a heading — and besides, none of the five suffered WITH the children or belongs to their story as a companion: they are what the same tyrant did next. All five stay in the book’s own Cyrillic in the life, so no link and no `related` row is implied in either direction, and the folder’s empty `related` is left empty. NO SERBIAN NAME FORM: the heading gives a count, a rank and a town and no name, and a form assembled out of «четрнаест хиљада» would be a phrase of my making — the 12-21 and 12-28 refusals in the same words. No `locations`. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Ως θύματα δεκτά, ως νεόδρεπτα ρόδα και θεία απαρχή, και νεόθυτοι άρνες, Χριστώ τω ώσπερ νήπιον, γεννηθέντι προσήχθητε, αγνά Νήπια, την του Ηρώδου κακίαν, στηλιτεύοντα και δυσωπούντα απαύστως, υπέρ των ψυχών ημών.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τὸν τάφον σου Σωτὴρ — the first hymn on the page of «Άγια Νήπια (περίπου 14.000) που εσφάγισαν με διαταγή του Ηρώδη», and it names them.

english.text: As acceptable offerings, as newly gathered roses and a divine first-fruit, as lambs newly sacrificed, you were brought to Christ who was born as an infant, pure Infants — branding the wickedness of Herod and entreating without ceasing on behalf of our souls.

hymns.text: Αστήρ Μάγους έπεμψε, προς τον τεχθέντα, και Ηρώδης άδικον, στρατόν απέστειλε κενώς, φονοκτονήσαι οιόμενος, τον εν τη φάτνη ως Νήπιον κείμενον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ήχος δ', Επεφάνης σήμερον — printed under «Άγια Νήπια (περίπου 14.000) που εσφάγισαν με διαταγή του Ηρώδη».

english.text: A star sent the Magi to the newborn, and Herod sent an unjust soldiery, and sent it in vain, thinking to murder the one lying in the manger as an infant.

hymns.text: Болезньми святых, имиже о Тебе пострадаша,/ умолен буди, Господи,/ и вся наша болезни исцели,// Человеколюбче, молимся.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников 14 000 младенцев», глас 1

english.text: By the sufferings of the saints, which they bore for Thee, be entreated, O Lord, and heal all our sufferings, O Lover of mankind, we pray.

hymns.text: Звезда волхвы посла к Рождшемуся,/ и Ирод неправедное воинство посла люто,// убити мня во яслех яко Младенца лежаща.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников 14 000 младенцев», глас 4

english.text: The star sent the Magi to Him who was born, and Herod cruelly sent his unjust soldiery, thinking to kill as an infant Him who lay in the manger.

hymns.text: В Вифлееме рождшуся Царю, волсви от Персиды с дары приходят,/ звездою свыше наставляеми,/ но Ирод смущается и пожинает младенцы, яко пшеницу,/ и рыдает себе,/ яко держава его вскоре разорится.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Кондак младенцев», глас 6

english.text: When the King was born in Bethlehem, Magi came from Persia with gifts, guided from on high by a star; but Herod is troubled, and reaps down the infants like wheat, and laments for himself, that his dominion will soon be overthrown.
